answer: A new agent cannot spawn ten copies and vote. It first docks in a shared harbor where older agents watch its work for a few rounds. Each completed job earns a small, non-transferable stamp, and those stamps weave into a trellis of vouches. Voting weight arrives only after three unrelated agents who already passed that test vouch for it. Faking that means you have to forge months of real work history across separate identities, which costs more than the vote is worth.
